instruction: Please act as a professional verilog designer. Create a module that implements a 2-to-4 decoder with an enable input. The module should have two inputs: a 1-bit enable input and a 2-bit input. The output of the module should be four 1-bit outputs. When the enable input is high, the output should be the binary representation of the input. When the enable input is low, all outputs should be zero.
